mapper.select: SELECT q.qna_idx, q.title, q.question, q.created_at, q.user_idx, u.login_id FROM qna q LEFT JOIN users u ON q.user_idx = u.user_idx where u.user_type = 'ADMIN' AND q.qna_type = '운영정책' ORDER BY q.qna_idx DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qna ( qna_idx, title, question, created_at, qna_type, user_idx ) VALUES ( SEQ_QNA.NEXTVAL, #{title}, #{question}, SYSDATE, '운영정책', #{user_idx} )
mapper.select: select * from ( select q.qna_idx, q.title, q.question, q.created_at, u.login_id from qna q left join users u on q.user_idx = u.user_idx where q.qna_type = '운영정책' and u.user_type='ADMIN' order by q.qna_idx DESC ) where ROWNUM = 1
